summary: Jumia Technologies AG, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting a capital increase via private placements. On August 12, 2026, IFC subscribed for 9,057,970 new ordinary shares in ADS form (~US$25M) and Axian with other investors purchased 4,528,983 new ADSs (~US$25M) at US$5.52 per ADS, generating gross proceeds of US$50M. The transaction pre-empts shareholder subscription rights under authorized capital 2026/I. Proceeds fund growth in African markets. Closing expected late August 2026. Watch for regulatory clearances and overhang from new share issuance.
